subject: Competitive offer review — bridge credit vs custom bundle
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenfield.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.p@greenfield.ai>, procure@greenfield.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Pricing note — competitor match request

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the numbers and received an aggressive offer from a competitor that would reduce our per-inference unit cost by ~22% — but it comes with a 6–8 week migration window and some feature gaps around per-route observability.

Before we move any further, procurement asked if Redwood can match the effective economics or propose an alternative that reduces our migration risk (i.e., credits, onboarding support, or a customized bundle). Our key asks: predictable per-token pricing close to the competitor, onboarding credits to cover migration labor, and a clear rollback plan.

Can you confirm whether Redwood is willing to do a price match or if you have a structured counteroffer we can review? We're working to a quarter-end decision, so timing is tight.

Best,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering
Greenfield Analytics

--
Attachment: RFP_summary_greenfield.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing note — competitor match request

Alex — thanks for the transparency and for sharing the competitor economics. We definitely want to keep Greenfield on Redwood.

Quick next steps from my side: I've looped in Nikhil for pricing and Marcus for commercial flexibility. Diego will scope the migration/regression work so we can quantify onboarding credits. We'll aim to put a formal counter on the table by tomorrow EOD.

Couple of quick clarifying Qs for your team so our counter is targeted:
- Is the competitor pricing tied to a committed annual volume or month-to-month?
- Are there specific platform features you consider must-have (observability, KV-cache persistence, per-route SLAs)?

If it's easier, can we spin up a 30-minute call tomorrow morning with procurement and platform to walk through the tradeoffs?

Thanks — Priya
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0182

--
Signature: Priya Natarajan | Redwood Inference

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Pricing note — competitor match request

Alex — appreciate the heads up. Based on the details so far, Redwood can approach this as a conditional price-match + migration risk mitigation package. Outline below (attachment: rdw_bridge_credit_terms.pdf):

1) Conditional bridge credit (time-bound):
   - 20% effective per-inference credit off list for the first 4 months, provided Greenfield signs a 12-month committed consumption agreement (min monthly $40k commit).
   - Credits apply to standard inference units only; embeddings and special workloads priced separately.

2) Custom bundle:
   - 10% ongoing list discount on the committed tier after the initial 4-month credit period OR a fixed rate reduction if Greenfield prefers predictability. We can model both.
   - Includes 40 hours of professional services for migration assistance (onboard plan, validations, evals). Additional PS at discounted rate.

3) Migration SLA and rollback support:
   - Dedicated SE time during rollout, and a rollback playbook (we'll keep traffic mirrored for 2 weeks).

4) Time and gating:
   - Offer valid for acceptance through Aug 6, 2027.

Attached: rdw_bridge_credit_terms.pdf (terms summary). Also attaching a high-level model in the Drive link Priya shared. If that framework works, Diego will send a line-by-line migration estimate tomorrow.

If you want, we can trade the initial credit depth for a longer commit term (18 months) or higher commit to reduce the payback window.

Best,
Nikhil
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: rdw_bridge_credit_terms.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

From: Maya Patel <maya.p@greenfield.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenfield.ai>, procure@greenfield.ai
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing note — competitor match request

Nikhil / Priya — thanks for the proposal. A few clarifying items procurement needs before we can take this to legal: 
- Please provide a bottom-line effective price per 1M inference tokens over the first 12 months, accounting for credits and PS. We need the net ARR impact.
- Itemize the migration credits vs professional services hours and confirm whether unused PS hours can be rolled into future quarters.
- Confirm whether observability feature parity (route-level latency histograms, token-level cost breakdown) will be included in the custom bundle or remains roadmap.

We prefer a single-sheet economics model. If you can send that, we will review and share internally.

Thanks,
Maya
Head of Platform Operations | Greenfield Analytics

--
Procurement: procurement@greenfield.ai

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.p@greenfield.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Pricing note — competitor match request — migration estimate

Maya / Alex — attaching a migration estimate workbook (migration_estimate_greenfield.xlsx) and a short runbook. Summary here: 
- Estimated migration engineering effort: 120–160 engineering hours (pilot + phased rollout + rollback validation).
- PS covered in commercial offer: 40 hours (included). Remaining ~80–120 hours estimated as incremental engineering (we recommend a 50% dedicated buffer to allow for nonstandard evals).
- Risk mitigations: prefix caching warmup plan (reduces cold-start token volume by ~35%), automated canary with traffic mirroring, and test harness for evals.
- Timeline: pilot (2 weeks) + phased 4-week rollout = ~6 weeks total (aligns with your note).

Note on pricing model ask: to give a single-sheet net price I need a committed monthly volume assumption. For modeling purposes, I'm using 45M infer tokens/month in the attached workbook — happy to re-run for a different baseline.

Quoted attachments: migration_estimate_greenfield.xlsx (spreadsheet, stub).

— Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing note — competitor match request

Priya / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the materials. Procurement reviewed the migration workbook and the terms summary. A couple final asks before we route to legal: 
1) Can you convert the conditional bridge credit offer into a firm effective per-1M-token price for the first 12 months (this should include the 4-month credit blended across the year) and show the comparison vs the competitor's stated rate?
2) Will the 40 included PS hours be transferable to another internal team if we don't use them in Q3? Procurement prefers at least partial carry-forward.
3) If we accept the 12-month commit with the bridge credit, can Redwood guarantee a maximum per-request latency SLO for our top 3 routes during onboarding window?

If you can provide a one-page amendment or term sheet with the numeric model and the answers to the three requests by COB Wednesday (Aug 4), we can expedite legal review. Otherwise we'll need to schedule a call with procurement/legal.

Appreciate it — Alex
